notes.title: Kapital Punishment 0.4.0.3 QoL Update
notes.content:
Hi! We hope you're enjoy Act I of Story Mode. We've watched a lot of streams and caught a few bugs, especially with that giant nazi chicken. Here are some hotfixes. Enjoy!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Fix for Energy Shield which disappeared under certain interactions.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed where settings screen was inaccessible on the one-time Select Language scene first time users see.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed a potential softlock in 1-1 due to gate closing slowly.
[*] Bug Fix: 1-3 secret gate is no longer an enemy gate, but a normal gate instead.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed where player could not be targeted by certain units upon left ledge grabbing
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed issue in 1-8 where comrades would get stuck beyond the left edge of the level
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed issues where 1-8 comrades would get stuck in their idle state, until the player came and got them.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed issue in 1-8 where Fly Kops could fly and attack the player beyond the left edge of the level.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed issue where gate in 1-3 wasn't closing, allowing enemies from the shipping area into the rest of the map where they'd get stuck.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed issue where weapons pickups could mess up level save states and cause player to respawn after death with arena fights complete.
[*] Bug Fix: Camera now transitioning back to the player correctly in cutscenes.
[*] Balance: Comrades have now knockback threshold of 3. They're harder to knockback.
[*] QoL: 1-2 now saves after clearing initial enemies. No need to fight foes again before Wave fight.
[*] QoL: Gates which open after killing enemies in 1-3 are enemy gates.
[*] QoL: Achievement dismiss clue no longer covered by steam pop up
[*] QoL: When recruiting Titus in Story Mode, dialog shows button hint.
[*] QoL: Titus and Brother can now activate their powers while climbing.
[*] QoL: Upon completing a level, player avatar moves automatically to next level in world map.
[*] QoL: Control now explained on World Map.
[*] Other: Added music to Shareware Screen at end of Act I
[/list]

notes.title: End of Month Progress Report: May
notes.content:
Hi! It seems it’s already time for another end of month progress report!

[h1]Name Change[/h1]

First things first. KOP KILLER 22XX is now KAPITAL PUNISHMENT 22XX! As much as we liked the original title, it didn’t lend itself to open discussion of the game. We were comfortable with taking the risk, but after a lot of discussion we came to realize not everyone’s in a position to do the same. We feel the new title solves that issue while aligning with the content and theme of the game even better. We hope you agree! KAPITAL PUNISHMENT 22XX is here to stay and reach new audiences!

[h1]ACT I on JUNE 8th![/h1]

Get hype! Story Mode Act I will debut on June 8th! Get ready to fight your way through 8 challenging, hand-crafted levels each with its own unique twist. Here’s a small preview:

Escape your nefarious captors through a gauntlet of platforming challenges.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/32f801c2f33848ba14df8fbd4bd33ab539dcaf6f.png[/img]

Battle waves of foes as your fight to free your fellow prisoners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/21670bf0df334fd44b882c961243de68bff90162.png[/img]

Explore Homan Corrections with the help of your comrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/cad0c066d6c21627cff5a09317c6efb20a06d58f.png[/img]

Kill over 100 fascists.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/237c3d57e09497f41b8fdf400f74a7d228f68556.png[/img]

We’ve been working overtime to get this release super polished. Beyond the new content we’ve added too many quality of life improvements to list here. We’ve got 2 rockin’ boss fights, revamped UI, full Spanish translation, and loads of secrets and surprises. We’ve improved comrade AI beyond what you’ve seen in Arcade Mode, and optimized things to run buttery smooth.

We’ll be putting the game on sale (33% off) for two weeks starting June 8th and need your help to spread the word! KAPITAL PUNISHMENT 22XX! Tell everyone! Gaming forums, twitter, Tik Tok, reddit. If you haven’t already, leave a review! Reviews help more than anything else. Finally you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/morningstargamestudio]discord[/url] and share your feedback on the game itself!

Thanks
Matt (MGS)
Dr. Shameless Cat (DSCG)

notes.title: End of the Month Progress Report: April
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Our game has been in Early Access for nearly two months now, and we wanted to update you on our progress and future plans. For one, we plan to start making a post like this at the end of each month. But, before I dive into more information about Act I, there are two important issues I have to address. 

[h1]PRICE CHANGE[/h1]
With the Combo Update, we’ve increased the game's price from $2.99 to $4.99. As we’ve said, as we release major updates we’ll gradually increase the price. However, we initially anticipated doing this alongside the larger Story Mode updates. Instead, we’ve chosen to up the price early so that when Act I releases, we can run a sale and hopefully gain some visibility. (You can’t run a sale within 30 days of a price increase.) We’re pretty buried on the store page at the moment, and a sale will help. If you’re reading this you likely already own the game, but we wanted to be transparent. Also, we want to clarify we won’t increase the price again until (~30 days before) the next major update after Act I of Story Mode.

[h1]NAME CHANGE[/h1]
On the topic of visibility, we also want to announce that we’re changing the title of the game. I like the title KOP KILLER 22XX. It goes hard. However, it’s hurt us when it comes to promoting the game. We want this game, its themes, and its content to be as uncompromising as possible, but if no one ever sees it, that doesn’t matter. There are other factors that have limited the game’s reach, but we’ve received multiple messages from streamers and press outlets expressing that they’d cover the game if not for its title. The algorithm does not approve.


[h1]STORY MODE[/h1]
Anyways, on to the fun stuff!

Act I of Story Mode should be publicly available no later than the middle of June. The title change will cause a slight delay as we update the store page, title screen, etc. but the content for Act I is largely finished. To give you just a taste of what’s on the way, here are some screenshots followed by a brief explanation of what to expect:

[h2]Boss Fights[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/f9d64334c2736a4557762d49704e00cff4a5358a.gif[/img]
You’ve likely seen this big fascist chicken in the trailer. This ED-209 inspired boss is named after a greedy prince of Hell and dimwitted nazi dog whistle. The creeps at Homan Corrections are even less subtle than the goofuses that named their game Kop Killer. Mammon sports two massive miniguns, beak-mounted flamethrower, and a missile rack with a lock-on guidance system. The perfect tool for stopping every crime from loitering to non-violent street protests. The fight itself will require help from all your comrades to win!

[h2]Platforming[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/32da20c78b41151752b35a8f4f369baae3a1d598.gif[/img]
That’s right! Story mode is more than just brawling. It includes plenty of hand-crafted platforming to keep you on your toes. All of the abilities in your core move-set really shine here. More traditional platforming foes with simple movement patterns are interspersed with the more relentless AI Kops.

[h2]Story (duh!)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/2ff9555d6d9ee1d1d71e01152abe60ce51afeed7.gif[/img]
Unlike Arcade Mode, your comrades in Act I have more than one line of dialogue. You’ll begin to learn the backstories of Titus, Vilma, Brother and Shakeel in this installment. You’ll discover more about the nature of Homan’s nefarious deeds and the grim world of the 23rd century.

[h2]Secrets[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/7bb58deeb160ab2fd949f51e3115f309f95f3a3f.gif[/img]
Story mode features numerous secrets to discover. Exploration is rewarded with powerful upgrades. But beware! Most of these powerful upgrades are guarded by puzzles and combat challenges.

Hopefully, this preview whets your appetite until we can make Act I publicly available. We’re at the finish line and just adding polish / fixing bugs. We can’t wait for your feedback to help us make the game even better. Please share your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: C-C-C-COMBO UPDATE! 0.3.4.3 is now live.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/e45a503acfaecc814df32e67bd9f131c0e4ac045.png[/img]

The KOP KILLER 22XX C-C-C-COMBO UPDATE has just gone live! This update features a brand new combo system to help you push your score to the limit through expert play. Combos build up as you deal damage to enemies within 2-second intervals. As your combo climbs higher you gain a score multiplier that boosts the points gained from killing enemies. When your combo finally ends you're awarded another large bonus based on its size. However, if you take damage during the combo it breaks and you lose this large bonus.

Additionally, we've added 6 new upgrades that interact with this combo system. Regenerate health as your combo climbs higher. Unleash a devastating energy wave when your combo finishes. Repel enemies when your combo is broken. All of these upgrades come with new achievements to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/75f3e5982129fc381af15bf4e1ca18b7b4ae33ad.png[/img]

Finally, for the top of the leaderboards, we've extended the late game and added even tougher KOPs. 6 new Tier 4 enemies provide additional challenge and surprises along with brand new art.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/f445472d7ea605241de14eaf124a785cd7fb8e04.png[/img]

The main focus of this update has been to address the game's difficulty curve to grant struggling players a better experience and experienced players a greater challenge. The game's first month has illustrated that many players struggle to get past the first several arenas of Arcade mode but that those who do eventually reach a point where the power provided by the upgrades begins to outpace the difficulty of the enemies. We've made a number of changes to lower the entry-level difficulty but steepen the curve to make the leaderboards more fun and competitive.

Finally, for those that need an extra helping hand, many arenas now let you free your fellow prisoners...
[previewyoutube=3W40s_UW3gE;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/b99f6390198c9c94cf4451f6f7e5ada294c1c6fb.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Combo System that applies a score multiplier during combos and a bonus on completion.
[*] 6 New Combo Themed Upgrades with 6 New Achievements!
[*] Free Prisoners mid-fight to act as temporary allies!
[*] New Turret Drones and Minigun Drones.
[*] 6 Super Hard Tier 4 Enemies with unique art. (Arena 20+)
[*] New Score and Time Extending Upgrades for the late game.
[*] New Arena-Chunk variants.
[*] New scene before tutorial.
[/list]
[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Arena Difficulty pushed back by 1 Arena. The first Arena is easier, then second arena has same difficulty as the first used to and so on.
[*] Only 1 Shield Kop can appear in Arena 3.
[*] Arcade Countdown Timer doesn't start till Arena 30.
[*] Vilma's attack speed increases more while raging.
[*] While raging, Vilma has increased knockback.
[*] Tier 3 Turret Builders No longer invincible while building turrets.
[*] Tier 3 Turret Builders Max Turrets decreased from 6 to 5.
[*] Tier 3 Turret Builders Max Health increased to 12.
[*] Ammo, Health and Cooldown Pickup Upgrades limited to 2 Max.
[*] Starting at Arena 20 the upgrade pool offered after each arena shrinks until only time and score upgrade are offered.
[*] FK-12 now only requires you clear 4 Lab Arenas in a single run to unlock.
[*] FK-12's projectile barrage fires fewer rounds and fires them faster
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked Tutorial for better clarity.
[*] Moved item spawns in upgrade room so that they're not covered by Stat UI
[*] Enemy layer now behind Player layer
[*] Upgrades of the same type now have a number instead of appearing multiple times in the Pause Menu.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Comrades resurrect now with their proper stats according to arenas cleared.
[*] Hordes of Turret Builders no longer cause tremendous slow down
[*] Weapons can now be picked up while crouching
[*] Comrades can now be revived while crouching
[*] Projectiles no longer collide with dying combatants as they're falling
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/c915f3ad2098a8150c65e4606d0d2a57ca014375.png[/img]
This update isn't all we've been working on! We're in the home stretch of finishing [b]ACT I[/b] of KOP KILLER 22XX's story mode. We hope to release this major update sometime in late May / early June.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43331314/dba9b599d4b9aa098d4b4f4dc1a0611dceee10f4.png[/img]

In the interim we'll leave you with this WIP preview of [b]ACT I[/b]'s World Map.

-Matt (MGS) & Dr. Shameless Cat (DSCG)
